blocks.text: YouTube sensation Rachel Griffin Accurso, popularly known as Ms. Rachel, extended help to a Filipino mom who appealed for donation for her child suffering from a rare birth condition. Daisilyn Mejia reached out to Accurso through Threads last Friday, Oct. 2, sharing the condition of her son who was diagnosed with omphalocele. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, omphalocele is a birth defect of the abdominal wall where “the infant’s intestines, liver, or other organs stick outside of the belly through the belly button.” In her post, Mejia shared a video of her older son singing Accurso’s “I […]...
